Text formatting

Turn markup into Telegram message or caption entities.

Send formatted messages

Use parse_mode="markdown" for Markdown. The formatted text and its entities are sent through the account-bound host API.

Work with entities directly

extera_utils.text_formatting.parse_text returns the text and entities. For a caption, request caption output. Telegram entity offsets use UTF-16 code units, so preserve the returned offsets when writing a reply or update.
